notes.title: UPDATE 1.4 AVAILABLE NOW WITH HORDE MODE AND 50% OFF FOR A LIMITED TIME
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.4.1 - 27 Sept 2024

- Fixes for two complex crashes showing up in logs
- Changed the grab function from being bound to Valve Index squeeze for improved comfort.

[previewyoutube=ZserjeWGGV4;full][/previewyoutube]
Wanna see the uncensored version? Click here

Almost eight months to the day since its initial release on January 18 - Bulletstorm VR brings its biggest and most badass update with the release of version 1.4 today, which includes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/8944e456e9cb8cdb5ab99669906e3ce2fc8fffc1.png
Click to watch the Horde Mode trailer.

Horde Mode throws you into three new and bespoke murder domes to face increasingly difficult waves of enemies in your bid to survive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/44531d1fd8ed78063c2fe6dcd48e8553c60553e2.png
Five Brand New Skillshots that make the most of the VR exclusive dual wielding have you stylin’ and profiling their way across Stygia.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/cd80bd7eb2919d214b109be631ef581b34fd1146.jpg
Click to watch the Iconic Arsenal playlist.

Immersive Charged Shots have you physically twist, turn, pull, push, or rip at your weapon of choice to send it into overdrive mode.

-----------------------------------------

Along with the new additions are several improvements and upgrades that will help more players step into the ass-kicking boots of Grayson Hunt.

 Leaderboards to see who has skillshot superiority in both the campaign levels and the new Horde Mode.
 Improved levels, visuals, and performance with more VR interactivity, higher fidelity, and smoother gameplay.
 Left-handed support is needed for left-leaning locomotioners to be able to switch their movement thumbstick.
 Adjustable Holsters to completely tailor your holsters to your needs, whether you’re seated, standing, tall, or small.
 Korean and Simplified Chinese Subtitles extend the language support already offered in the game to accommodate our players in these countries better.


The complete list of improvements and patch notes for update 1.4 are here.

To celebrate the release of this major update, Bulletstorm VR is available for a limited time at 50% off until 29 September at 10:00 Pacific Time.

We're incredibly thankful for the continued support we've received from our players and hope you have a kickass time in Bulletstorm VR 1.4! For more information and support, please check out https://bulletstorm.com

notes.title: Wield the Iconic Arsenal in VR
notes.content:
New immersive charged shots and overall improvements to the complete iconic arsenal of weapons in Bulletstorm VR are coming in update 1.4. For a sneak preview, check out the videos below:

The Peacemaker Carbine
Charge up and Eviscerate your enemies in VR with the Peacemaker Carbine and let 'er rip with the new ripcord charge shot.

[previewyoutube=vT7C0M6IHfg;full][/previewyoutube]

The Screamer

Think you've got skills? The Screamer is a trick shooter's dream. With great range, accuracy, and power, and a new twist-charged flare action - just remember not to blow your load too quickly! 

[previewyoutube=qn34Qwj6gUk;full][/previewyoutube]

The Boneduster

Slap the big red skull button and turn their souls to ash with this brick shithouse of a gun! Your enemies won't even think about thinking before the Boneduster obliterates their entire being! 

[previewyoutube=fD7PWGnG2uo;full][/previewyoutube]

The Penetrator

Fancy ejecting some high-velocity self-motorized drill bits that can impale enemies into any surface? We thought so! Grab the Penetrator then twist and drill it right into their thick skulls so they understand! 

[previewyoutube=2lEbtC0woDo;full][/previewyoutube]

The Flailgun

Whoever thought of making a gun that shoots two grenades tied together needs a raise because this is awesome! Watch your enemies try to wriggle outta the wrath of the Flailgun!

[previewyoutube=Z2p_XrkvO_I;full][/previewyoutube]

The Headhunter

Headhunters the name, headshots the game - With each round containing a radio-controlled guidance device directed by your head, whip your bullets around corners and obstacles to go full ‘Wanted’ on their ass.

[previewyoutube=ICfQS1V1Wzc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Bouncer

This massive bazooka fires impact-resistant explosive rounds that bounce off any surface, making it easy to dispatch that annoying asshole on the ledge above you from downtown.

[previewyoutube=r0h5krWepl8;full][/previewyoutube]

To keep on top of our latest videos, subscribe to our YouTube

Wield the Iconic Arsenal Now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451320/Bulletstorm_VR/

For more information on whats coming to update 1.4, head to bulletstorm.com

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451320/Bulletstorm_VR/

Key Fixes

 The uncensored version of the game is now available in options.
 Pest Control Trophy can now be achieved.


Improvements

 Fixed several more crashes and bugs covering a wide range of scenarios.
 Cutscene quality is improved. 
 UI improvements on immersive and semi-immersive weapon reload options


Optimization & Quality of Life Improvements

 Fixed collision volumes in level 0-3 to avoid invisible walls blocking progression
 VFX fixed when equipping the Energy leash for the first time
 Added surface collision VFX when firing the Penetrator


AI

 Added explosion impulse reactions and reload animations to allies.


Sound/Music

 A heartbeat sound has been added to indicate when your health is low
 Death music readded to the game.
 Volume on Cinematics is no longer mismatched against gameplay volume.
 Fix for when certain SFX and Cutscene audio can be heard in the game when Master Volume is set to zero.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451320/Bulletstorm_VR/

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451320/Bulletstorm_VR/

Key Fixes

 Fixed several more crashes covering a wide range of scenarios.
 Video options now include graphics presets and options for Texture quality, Shadow Quality, Volumetric Fog, and Anti-Aliasing.
 Achievement/Trophy “Red Barrels” is now possible to achieve.
 Fixed blockers on the Last train from the explosion town (1-2) level, where the player stays on the wrong side of the hangar door and kills all enemies with the Boneduster weapon, can halt progression.
 Fixed a progression blocker on I don’t hold you accountable (5-2) level.
 Fixed the cutscene at the end of Act 3, where it sometimes didn’t appear. 
 Fixed a blocker in the prologue where leashing the second obstacle before the encounter will halt progression.
 Higher-quality particles are now available throughout the game


Optimization & Quality of Life Improvements

 Made several optimizations on Vultures to improve performance.
 Fixed the chaingun barrel looking warped while firing.
 Ishi’s body no longer floats on the Med Lab operating table.
 Fixed a bug where the game accepts inputs in the in-game pause menu while the headset isn’t being worn.


AI

 Fixed a blocker on the On the Road to hell (0-4) level, where getting in Whit “Doc” Oliver’s face when he’s meant to be “typing” will break his animation and halt progress.
 Added new idle animations for companions while out of combat.
 Fixed the Heavy Echo’s model, where the torso had the model swapped for one from an Echo Guard.


Sound/Music

 Added missing sound effects to Newsbots, Explosive barrels, and Elevator doors.
 Made improvements to sound volumes.
 Fixed several overlapping dialogues.


Known issues

 Possibility to require Reset View on launch with some hardware
 Options incorrectly being applied from one menu when applying changes are entered on a different menu.
 Achievement Pest Control can’t currently be achieved.
 Some SFX and all cutscene audio can still be heard throughout the game, even when the master volume is zero.
 The laser pointer disappears in the pause menu when taking off the headset.
 Trigger fingers are not animating correctly.
 The volume on Cinematics is mismatched against gameplay.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451320/Bulletstorm_VR/

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Bulletstorm VR
notes.content:
Please ensure you have SteamVR installed and running
https://store.steampowered.com/app/250820/SteamVR/

Key Fixes

 Fixes for multiple crashes covering a wide range of scenarios.
 Added Enhanced VFX (Leash, Explosions, Peacemaker Carbine Muzzleflash and Firing)
 Fixed instances where loading screens appear as a black screen
 Fixed a rare crash connected with changing languages multiple times with specific inputs.
 Fixed location where players die and respawn under the train moving train platform.
 Fixed a common crash caused by repeated reloads with the Headhunter.
 Fixed a bug where Boneduster charged shot did no damage to Vultures.
 Enemies hit by flail gun are now correctly stunned and unable to move/find cover.


Optimization & Quality of Life Improvements

 Additional optimization on loading screens and game HUD.
 Holding down the trigger when entering a cinematic will automatically skip it.
 Fixed the ammunition port on the Bouncer weapon to no longer be off-center.
 Fixed the Charged Shot VFX on the Headhunter.
 Fixed a culling volume in the bomb room in Act 4-2 that made parts of the level disappear too early.
 Smashing bottles now counts against collectibles found.


AI

 Improved AI on Driller Miniboss
 Fixed unresponsive AI in the Act 2-1 boss fight


Sound/Music

 Removed secondary background music in the game's credits
 Added missing sound effects to Ishi walking


Known Issues for future patches

 Triggering the cutscene in Act 1, Chapter 2, before eliminating all enemies, can cause a progression blocker.
 In rare cases, kicking the elevator in Act 0, Chapter 2 from an unusual angle can get the player locked behind.
 Heavy Echo's separated torso model needs to be corrected.
 Newsbots and Explosive barrels sometimes do not trigger explosion sound effects.
 In Act 1, Chapter 1, Ishi's body floats on the operating table.
 Placeholder interior of Hecaton Fight helicopter

notes.title: Bulletstorm VR is OUT NOW on Steam
notes.content:
Experience this brutal first-person action shooter that puts you in the ass-kicking boots of the hotheaded space mercenary Grayson Hunt and get the hands-on creative carnage experience with classic, fast-paced gunplay and devastating melee combos powered by fully redesigned controls for Virtual Reality.

As an exiled member of the elite assassin group Dead Echo, blinded by a thirst for vengeance, Grayson gets stranded in the hostile world of Stygia, where he has to confront the ex-commander who betrayed him.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/aba59af148441c20feabf35f4d00676adc00a5c6.png

EXCLUSIVE TRISHKA CONTENT
For the first time, lace up your badass mercenary babe boots as the legendary Trishka Novak exclusively in Bulletstorm VR. Dual-wield your new Energy Blade weapons to carve your way through mutated hordes in 2 brand-new levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/250d8d9972b869a5a3a062f35e5bc4502f341681.png

UNLEASH CREATIVE CARNAGE
Use power kicks, slides, charged shots, explosives, and your environment to execute a symphony of Skillshots. Aim for maximum carnage combos to ramp your rewards and unlock new weapons, charge shots, and ammo capacity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/eaaf1ff0e6390db9120c46344ebe4e0be55447cf.png

FIREPOWER AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Take the iconic Energy Leash and the entire Bulletstorm arsenal of weapons to the next level with exclusive dual-wielding in VR! See an enemy out of reach? Pull them in closer to admire the barrel of your gun or fling them into oncoming bullets for some not-so-friendly fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/f60304ec75d8da00b0c1d260df2bc53d5b89b45e.png

DESTROY ANYTHING AND EVERYTHING
Battle your way through hordes of Stygia's mutated inhabitants! Gun down everything in your path, from crazy raiders to colossal skyscraper-sized beasts, as you cut a swathe of destruction through badlands, urban ruins, and terror domes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192713/762349ab0b3106b564a91628751b66d10dfb045c.png
